newsitem.title: USA: Mass Lt. Gov. spent bundle on Hollywood trip - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mass Lt. Gov. spent bundle on Hollywood trip - paper.

text.p: Massachusetts Lt. Gov. and Republican gubernatorial contender Paul Cellucci spent $41,000 on a four-day trade mission to Hollywood, The Boston Herald reported Tuesday.

Spokesmen for Cellucci, who is preparing for a 1998 run for governor, were unavailable to comment on the report which claimed the trip cost Massachusetts taxpayers twice as much as state officials said at a press conference two weeks ago.

Massachusetts taxpayers were billed $15,000 for a lobster feast on Malibu Beach along with valet parking fees for guests such as actor Sylvester Stallone and David Chokachi, a star on the television show "Baywatch."
Cellucci led the April trip as his first act after receiving word that he would become acting governor this fall, the newspaper said.
Massachusetts Gov. William Weld is expected to be named U.S. Ambassador to Mexico some time this year.
